subprocess_flow.substep_name: Collate Dossier and Run Automated Verification Checks
subprocess_flow.description: Consolidate all upstream stage deliverables and governance records into a structured stage-gate compliance package. Execute automated verification scripts to validate artifact checksums, cryptographic attestations, and compliance threshold metrics across data quality, security posture, and fairness assessments, identifying intake discrepancies before board inspection.
success_criteria: 100% of mandatory gate artifacts submitted and structurally verified
Automated validation script passes with zero missing metadata fields
Automated Gate Verification Check Report successfully published to registry
subprocess_flow.purpose: Perform automated structural verification and integrity validation of the complete AI compliance dossier prior to human governance review.
subprocess_flow.scope: Ingestion verification and automated checklist validation of Phase 1 through 4 governance artifacts.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of formal stage-gate evaluation submission from AI Project Lead
end_conditions: Generation of Automated Gate Verification Check Report and compiled dossier ready for routing

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Submission of manipulated, mismatched, or out-of-date audit documentation
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated cryptographic checksum verification comparing submitted deliverables against tamper-proof registry logs

governance_requirements: UK Government Service Standard Gate Reviews

change_management.change_request_process: Missing or non-verifiable artifacts trigger an automated intake halt and remediation ticket in Jira/ServiceNow
change_management.versioning_rules: Compiled dossier tagged with immutable Git SHA and semantic release version

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Triage Approval Route and Distribute for Pre-Review
subprocess_flow.description: Assess the verified compliance dossier against the Delegated Approval Eligibility Matrix to determine whether the system qualifies for expedited delegated review or requires full board deliberation. Generate pre-populated asynchronous review comments and route the evaluation pack to designated subject matter experts across data privacy, security, and algorithmic ethics.
dependencies: Collate Dossier and Run Automated Verification Checks
success_criteria: Approval pathway formally assigned in accordance with risk tier criteria
Pre-review workspace pre-populated with automated findings and review prompts
Delegated Approval Manifest created for qualified low-risk use cases
subprocess_flow.purpose: Determine whether the AI solution requires full board quorum or delegated lead evaluation, streamlining review distribution.
subprocess_flow.scope: Risk-calibrated pathway assignment and distribution of pre-review packages across MoJ specialist domains.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Successful completion of automated verification checks
end_conditions: Reviewers notified and dossier dispatched via designated governance review channels

step_risks_and_controls.risk: High-risk judicial decision-support tool erroneously assigned to delegated fast-track review
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory policy rule-engine cross-check validating against statutory high-risk exclusion lists

governance_requirements: EU AI Act High-Risk System Classification Criteria
CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard Tiering

change_management.change_request_process: Appeals against pathway categorization require written concurrence from Chief Enterprise Architect
change_management.versioning_rules: Pathway determination logged with timestamped configuration manifest

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Execute Asynchronous Pre-Review and Concurrent Sign-Off
subprocess_flow.description: Enable domain reviewers across cyber security, legal compliance, data protection, and algorithmic ethics to evaluate their designated areas asynchronously. Record concurrent non-blocking approvals and domain attestations directly into the central governance platform, isolating contentious issues and resolving minor technical queries without convening live meetings.
outputs: Asynchronous Pre-Review Record and Concurrent Sign-Off Dossier
dependencies: Triage Approval Route and Distribute for Pre-Review
success_criteria: All designated domain leads complete review logs within the allotted turnaround window
Zero non-blocking technical questions lingering unresolved
Concurrent sign-off registry populated with cryptographically verified digital signatures
subprocess_flow.purpose: Decouple domain-specific compliance validations into parallel workflows to eliminate review queues and bottlenecks.
subprocess_flow.scope: Parallel independent domain reviews covering GDPR Article 35, NIST AI RMF security baselines, and Equality Act conformance.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Dispatch of pre-review evaluation packs to designated domain leads
end_conditions: Logging of all domain evaluations and publication of concurrent sign-off registry

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Reviewer inactivity or late feedback delaying project release milestones
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated SLA countdown alerting with designated secondary delegate escalation after 24 business hours

governance_requirements: UK Data Protection Act 2018 / UK GDPR

change_management.change_request_process: Domain-level remediation requests logged directly into project issue tracker via MLOps bridge
change_management.versioning_rules: All asynchronous review comments and concurrent signatures permanently stored with cryptographic hashes

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Conduct Digital Quorum Voting and Delegated Review
subprocess_flow.description: Execute digital quorum voting across AI Governance Board members for full-track systems, or execute expedited single-lead sign-off for eligible low-risk systems. Collect digital voting tokens asynchronously to establish binding executive consensus, recording deliberations, vote distributions, formal determinations, and any mandatory conditions in the stage-gate review minutes.
inputs: Asynchronous Pre-Review Record and Concurrent Sign-Off Dossier
dependencies: Execute Asynchronous Pre-Review and Concurrent Sign-Off
success_criteria: Digital quorum met with required board majority or delegated lead sign-off confirmed
Stage-Gate Review Minutes recorded and digitally signed by the Board Chair or delegated lead
Zero governance stalls caused by physical board scheduling delays
subprocess_flow.purpose: Achieve authoritative, binding executive endorsement for production authorization through digital quorum voting or delegated authority.
subprocess_flow.scope: Governance Board voting, delegated single-lead approval execution, and formal recording of determinations.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of concurrent domain review completions and sign-off attestations
end_conditions: Formal ratification of board vote or delegated lead confirmation recorded in registry

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Voting tie or split board decision halting critical deployment schedules
step_risks_and_controls.control: Pre-defined escalation protocol granting casting vote authority to the MoJ Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO)

governance_requirements: UK Government Service Standard Gate Reviews

change_management.change_request_process: Gate rejection triggers a mandatory remediation process with automated notification to the AI Project Lead
change_management.versioning_rules: Review minutes and voting tallies archived under permanent immutable governance record IDs

improvement_inputs: Ratio of delegated vs full board determinations

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Process Conditional Remediation and Delegated Release
subprocess_flow.description: Review and verify evidence submitted to address minor conditional items or low-risk remediations stipulated during the evaluation. Allow the Board Chair or designated domain single lead to evaluate remediation packages asynchronously and issue conditional release sign-offs without requiring the entire governance board to reconvene.
dependencies: Conduct Digital Quorum Voting and Delegated Review
success_criteria: 100% of defined conditional remediation items verified against empirical evidence
Expedited single-lead or chair sign-off completed without convening the full board
Conditional Remediation Verification Certificate formally linked to project record
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide a streamlined, delegated mechanism to clear conditional gating actions without administrative re-convening overhead.
subprocess_flow.scope: Remediation verification for minor conditions, non-critical technical remediations, and conditional ATO grants.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Submission of remediation evidence package by AI Project Lead following conditional gate determination
end_conditions: Chair-delegated sign-off approved and Conditional Authority to Operate issued

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Conditional approval items unfulfilled prior to production environment provisioning
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated technical gating policy preventing production access tokens until verification certificate is sealed

governance_requirements: UK Government Service Standard Gate Reviews

change_management.change_request_process: Inadequate remediation submissions trigger immediate notice of deficiency with 5-day correction SLA
change_management.versioning_rules: Remediation manifests and chair approval notes versioned under secondary release tags

subprocess_flow.substep_name: Publish ATRS Filings and Issue Conformance Certificate
subprocess_flow.description: Compile the complete audit package and publish statutory algorithmic transparency records to central government registries in alignment with CDDO ATRS protocols. Cryptographically sign and release the final MoJ AI Certificate of Conformance and formal Authority to Operate (ATO), archiving the full compliance dossier under the mandatory 7-year retention rule and enabling production enclave access.
outputs: Signed MoJ AI Certificate of Conformance
dependencies: Process Conditional Remediation and Delegated Release
success_criteria: Algorithmic Transparency Record published and verified on central CDDO portal
MoJ AI Conformance Certificate cryptographically signed by enterprise governance authorities
Production cloud IAM credentials unlocked based on cryptographically validated ATO token
Full audit package securely archived for 7-year statutory retention
subprocess_flow.purpose: Fulfill central government algorithmic transparency obligations and grant authoritative production deployment authorization.
subprocess_flow.scope: Final ATRS publishing, cryptographic certificate generation, 7-year audit archival, and production environment release.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Ratification of unconditional gate determination or execution of conditional remediation verification
end_conditions: Formal issuance of Conformance Certificate, ATRS indexing, and production deployment authorization release

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Production deployment triggered without verifiable cryptographic authorization or transparency registration
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated cloud deployment orchestrator requiring cryptographically signed certificate hash to unlock production pipelines

governance_requirements: MoJ Records Management & Retention Policy (7-year rule)

change_management.change_request_process: Any post-authorization architecture modification revokes the Conformance Certificate and requires gate re-evaluation
change_management.versioning_rules: Signed certificates and published ATRS records stored with immutable SHA-256 hashes in central vault

improvement_inputs: Time elapsed between final approval and live environment release
External audit retrieval latency from 7-year archive
